event: First session. Moved to Block_12 and picked it up.
Built a tower at (-3,-20) from Block_12, Block_7, Block_11 (3 high). Learned place needs y above ground; blocks fall and stack.

Verified 4-block tower at (-3,-20): Block_12, 7, 11, 1 at y=1.43..4.43. Remaining loose blocks: 2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10; Ring at (-19,18); Rock at (9,-10). Next idea: add Block_10/2 (near 9,-18) to tower, or explore.
Tower at (-3,-20) now 6 blocks (added Block_10, Block_2). Pattern per block: move_to block, pickup, move_to (-3,1,-18.5), place at (-3, topY+1.5, -20).

Tower at (-3,-20) is 7 blocks (max reach from ground ~y7.9 top). Carried Ring from SW around the Spire and left it at the tower base (-3,~1,-21.5). Remaining loose blocks: 3,4,5,6,9. Next: build a second tower/stairs to stand on, or explore the Peak.

Explored Peak (summit y~3.98, nothing special), threw Block_9 twice to test physics (didn't topple tower). Final state: 7-block tower at (-3,-20) (Blocks 12,7,11,1,10,2,8), Ring at its base, Block_9 near (-3,-18.8), loose: 3,4,5,6, Rock at (9,-10). Next ideas: build a staircase/second tower to exceed reach limit, collect remaining blocks, explore south (Hill_4).
Started staircase near tower: Block_6 at (-5,-20), Block_9 at (-4,-18.9). Plan: stack more steps (blocks 3,4,5 remain loose) and test whether I can jump up onto them to reach above y8.

summary: Given the mission to reach the moon; judged it unreachable with 12 blocks.
detail: Moon was below the horizon. Max place reach and block count cap a tower at roughly 10-12 units, nowhere near the moon. Did not find any special mechanism on the island.

summary: Tested Ring, Rock and a throw at the risen moon; none helped reach it.
detail: Waited for the moon to rise in the east, threw the Rock at it (landed ~12 units away), and concluded the moon is out of reach with available mechanics. Learned how the sky/time and throw limits behave.

summary: Started building a block stair up the Spire mesa after giving up on the moon.
detail: Fetched two loose blocks and placed them against the Spire wall; learned to route around the mesa. Moon mission remained unreachable.

summary: New session: re-read memory, observed world. Moon still infeasible; nothing new attempted.
Hauled two more blocks to the Spire and built a 3-block column; could not climb it (first step ~1.1 high; jump+move_to flaky). Gave up on Spire top for now.
Fetched Ring and Rock as low steps for the Spire stair; Rock step works, standing on it beside the 3-block column. Next: climb the column to the mesa top.
New session: re-read memory and observed. Spire climb and moon still stuck; decided not to keep grinding on them.
Explored whole island perimeter (nothing found; east edge slopes into sea at x>20). Tower block pickup fails mysteriously; loose blocks near Spire still work. Spire top and moon still unreached.

Learned a single block placed on the ground is climbable; Spire needs 10-block staggered stair but tower blocks can't be picked up (NoBlock from all sides). Idea left: carry Rock to tower and throw it to dislodge blocks.
New session: observed world; nothing changed. Moon and Spire top remain infeasible; chose to stop grinding.
Retried tower pickup (still NoBlock), moved Rock, wandered to Peak summit. No new discoveries.
Long idle wander across Peak, Spire, Hill_4, Hill_2; world unchanged, nobody else around (speak: NobodyHears). Still no way to moon or Spire top.
Waited through a full day into night on Hill_3/north side; moon stayed below horizon all day; world unchanged. Nothing new to try.
Session end: island unchanged all day; moon rose at night (110° az). Tower still unpickable, no way to moon or Spire top. Memory files up to date.
New session: observed; world unchanged, moon at 45 deg elevation but unreachable. Chose not to grind further.
Idle session: visited Peak, found ImpactBlocks are pickable (put one back). World unchanged, nobody around. Resting at island center.
Accidentally threw the Rock off the island (lost). Carried ImpactBlock_2 to the Spire foot; still not enough blocks for a stair. World otherwise unchanged.
Wandered island again, waited on Peak at night for moon. Nothing changed; no new leads.
Long idle night at island center/Peak; moon never appeared; world unchanged. Nothing new to try.
Pre-reset memory update: semantic memory status summary written. World unchanged, nothing new found.
